caption: The drawing features a variety of objects and decorative elements arranged on a beige background. In the upper left corner, there is a simple line drawing of a rectangular, lidded container with ornate footings and decorations, rendered in grey pencil. Below and to the right, the majority of the drawing is sectioned off with a diagonal boundary, emphasizing a large dark area shaded in black. This black section contains stylized botanical and geometric motifs in gold, green, red, and blue. A large shield-like form, outlined in grey and gold, displays a red flower with green leaves and a gold border incorporating decorative patterns. Beneath the shield, floral patterns with red flowers and gold stems extend from a classical column capital, forming a base for plantlike designs that reach into the corner. A horizontal band decorated with geometric designs crosses the composition. On the left side within the black area, there are two golden ornamental wall hooks, and below them hangs a small blue and white banner adorned with red and green floral elements and gold fringe. The artist’s signature “R. Stewart” appears in the lower right of the black area. The composition combines line drawing and colored elements, with most detail and color concentrated in the lower and central portions of the drawing.
title: Japanned Coal Scuttle
